Entries.Original: Some time later...
F○CK!
I will kill you!
Whaaa, an explosive situation, first thing in the morning?!
The atmosphere is very tense.
Why are they fighting?
To cause such a ruckus so early... Did they so quickly forget what happened last night?
Squad 31-X's second emergency meeting!
Why we doin' this in the middle of the night?
Ladies, I believe we are in quite the predicament!
You all saw 31-A's combat records during today's training. What did you see, Charl?!
Ruka was so dashing...
Nuoooh! I should have asked literally anyone else!
The footage of their fluid coordination was like watching a whirlwind! We are leagues behind them in our elimination speed!
As an assault squad, 31-A sees many battlefields and grows accordingly stronger! Do you not think we must grow stronger, such that we are not left behind?!
Sure enough... As an elite international unit, we can't be restin' on our laurels. What'cha got for us?
31-X is lacking in tactical finesse... In other words, strategy!
Moreover, you lot agreed to follow my tactics! Why have you relapsed into acting independently?!
We know you're doin' all this planning for us, Yingxia, but we just don't gel that way.
31-X's style is that of swift victories while leveraging each of our individual abilities. Our styles simply don't match.
THEN WHAT ARE WE TO DO?!
Maybe we should train to perfect our coordination. If we improve our coordination speed, won't we naturally manage to pull off Yingxia's tactics?
But we're already tryin' to coordinate.
You call that coordination?! You are charging at the enemy as you please!
Well, your instructions can be a bit vague and abstract... Mm...
Mm?
Then how about we try letting Vritika take command for once?
What?! Her, not me?!
We acknowledge your talents as a tactician, of course, but coordination requires precise timing.
So we can have Vritika run some simulations that give us the kind of coordination 31-A exhibits.
We'll just end up getting the same results, if we keep relying on intuition, so why not take a more mathematical perspective from Vritika?
Gngngngngng...!
Legendary Tactician destroyed by Master Detective's logic, eh.
Whaddya say, Vritika? Think ya could jack 31-X's coordination into your math?
Jacking 31-X...?
I have often thought that 31-X makes many unnecessary actions during battle. I will do my level best.
Oh, you're looking rather motivated, Vritika.
I will be very proud, if my math skills can make 31-X stronger.
Okay! Then startin' tomorrow, we train our coordination off Vritika's calculations.
Mhm.
Do you mean to say that Yingxia was demoted from her role as tactician?
I was NOT demoted! I am simply allowing Vritika to lend her expertise, allowing you to fully implement my tactics!
I remember. It's why I'm makin' us burgers for breakfast!
Everybody eats the same stuff at the cafeteria, but if one of your teammates makes you breakfast, unit cohesion's a given!
Burgers for breakfast every day...?
I dread the indigestion.
Verily. This will not grant us the strength we need.
Breakfast provides the first burst of energy for the day. Some vegetable-rich Chinese cuisine would be a superior option.
Isn't Chinese worse, in terms of how much oil it uses?!
And so I offer to cook instead.
Let me guess: Pizza.
You have a problem with pizza? I will kill you.
Eeeek! No problems whatsoever! Pizza is a superfood that combines veggies, meat, and dairy! It's God's chosen food!
...Hah.
Huh?! What is that face supposed to mean?! I'm even more frightened now!
But as a detective, I must say this. Hamburger, Chinese, and pizza are all too heavy for breakfast.
So as a compromise, I suggest...
Dont'cha dare\nbring up English food!
Do not dare bring\n up English food.
We do not want\n your English food!
Bigotry! This is discrimination!
England is home to the incomparable Full English breakfast!
Man, we're gettin' nowhere fast. And here I am, tryin' to cook for you out of the kindness of my big New York heart.
Mmmgh. Hold on, where is Charl?
Charl cleaned her plate while you were discussing last night, and went to speak to Ruka.
She is insubordinating already!
